description: This Java class implements a servlet filter (ControlFilter) that manages access control for the OFBiz web application by allowing or redirecting requests based on configured allowed paths, redirect paths, and error codes. It handles URL validation, redirection logic, and security checks.

classes.name: ControlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that enforces an allowlist of URL paths for the OFBiz web application, redirecting or blocking requests based on configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters such as redirect path, allowed paths, error code, and whether to redirect all traffic.

methods.name: readErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer error code, defaulting to 403 if parsing fails.

methods.name: readAllowedPaths
methods.description: Splits a colon-separated string into a set of allowed path prefixes.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filtering logic that checks request URLs against allowed paths, handles redirection, security checks, and error responses.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to the configured redirect path, handling relative and absolute URLs.
